title: User guide: Signing in and roles
bullets: One Aadi account for all Aadi products
Who can do what in Academic Video Creation
subtitle: User guide: Signing in and roles
narration: Welcome. This short guide shows how to sign in to Academic Video Creation, and who can do what once you are in.

subtitle: Sign in with your Aadi account
narration: Open the Academic Video Creation address. You are taken to the Aadi sign in page. Enter your email and password, and click Sign in. It is the same account you use for other Aadi products, so there is no separate password.

title: If you cannot get in
bullets: Your company needs an Academic Video Creation subscription
You must be a member of the company
Forgot password? Use the link on the sign in page
Ask your Aadi administrator if you see Product not available
subtitle: If you cannot get in
narration: If you see a message that the product is not available, your company does not have a subscription yet, or you are not a member. Ask your Aadi administrator. If you forgot your password, use the link on the sign in page.

title: Roles
bullets: Admin: everything, and grants roles to people
Content operator: creates lessons, imports content, sends for review
Reviewer: approves, requests changes or rejects
subtitle: Roles
narration: There are four roles. An admin can do everything, and gives roles to other people. A content operator creates lessons, imports content and sends it for review. A reviewer approves, requests changes, or rejects. A production operator generates videos. The first person from a company to sign in becomes its admin. Everyone else starts read only, until an admin gives them a role.

title: Remember
bullets: Everything you see belongs to your company only
Sign out from the menu when you use a shared computer
Next: user guide 1, set up and create a lesson
subtitle: Next: user guide 1
narration: You only ever see your own company's lessons. Next, watch user guide one, to set up your classes and create your first lesson.
